data_objects.name: city_weather_observations
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped weather observations associated with a city.

variables.name: description
variables.meaning: Categorical text description of weather conditions.

variables.name: dt
variables.meaning: Numeric timestamp corresponding to the observation time.

variables.name: wind_deg
variables.meaning: Wind direction expressed as an angle.

variables.name: day
variables.meaning: Human-readable date and time of the observation.

structure.description: Each row is a city weather observation at one time; dt and day provide numeric and text encodings of that time.

uncertainties: Units are not stated for temperature, humidity, pressure, wind speed, or dist.
The timestamp epoch or scale for dt and the semantic role of dist are not explicitly documented.
annotation_notes: Weather meanings follow the source column labels without assuming undocumented measurement units.
